title: Shengshu Technology Launches Video Generation Model Vidu Q4 Preview, Supporting 4K Output and Multi-Image Multi-Audio References

content_html:
Shengshu Technology has officially released the preview version of its next-generation video generation flagship model - Vidu Q4 Preview. As a major upgrade tailored for scenarios such as film production, AI short plays, and advertising marketing, this model has made significant breakthroughs in video quality resolution, reference control capabilities, and lens expressiveness.

Core Features and Technical Highlights Upgrades

  • High Definition and High Frame Rate Output: Vidu Q4 Preview fully supports 2K and 4K high-resolution output, with 10-bit color depth, and can generate video clips up to 16 seconds in length in a single session.
  • Multi-dimensional Reference Control: The model supports both image-to-video and reference-based video generation. It can support up to 15 reference images, providing more comprehensive visual references for characters, scenes, and props; it also supports up to 3 reference audio segments, effectively ensuring consistency in character voice tones.
  • Complex Camera Movements and Seamless Transitions: In terms of generation results, this version further enhances dynamic camera movements, transition handling, and the smoothness of transitions between complex shots.

Competitive Pricing and Application Scenarios

To allow developers and creators to test their ideas at a lower cost, the introductory price of Vidu Q4 Preview starts at 0.09 yuan per second, and offers multiple specifications including 540P, 720P, 1080P, 2K, and 4K. Users can first test different opening and shot versions at a low cost, and then produce higher-quality final videos with high-resolution output.
